title: High-risk Human Papillomavirus Genotypes in Women Undergoing Cervical Screening in Leshan, China: Real-time and Nested Multiplex PCR
abstract: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is the principal etiological factor in cervical precancer and cervical cancer. Regional surveillance of HR-HPV prevalence and genotype distribution is important because circulating genotypes may vary according to geography, age structure, screening access, and vaccination coverage. This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated HR-HPV infection among women undergoing routine cervical cancer screening at Leshan Maternal and Child Health Hospital, Leshan, Sichuan, China, between January 2022 and December 2024. A total of 5,000 eligible women aged 25-60 years were included. Cervical specimens were collected from the transformation zone using a sterile cytobrush and preserved in liquid-based cytology medium. Primary HR-HPV detection was performed using the Roche Cobas 4800 HPV assay, which detects HPV16 and HPV18 individually and detects 12 additional high-risk genotypes as a pooled result. Samples positive for pooled HR-HPV were further analyzed by nested multiplex PCR to identify additional genotypes. Cytology and histopathology results, where available, were reviewed and correlated with HPV detection results. Among 5,000 screened women, 612 were HR-HPV positive, corresponding to an overall prevalence of 12.2%. Single-genotype infections accounted for 65.7% of HPV-positive cases, while multiple-genotype infections accounted for 34.3%. HPV16 was the most frequent genotype, followed by HPV31, HPV56, HPV66, and HPV51. HR-HPV prevalence was highest in women aged 25-30 years and declined with increasing age. Multivariate analysis showed that age below 35 years, multiple sexual partners, smoking, and lack of prior screening were associated with higher odds of HR-HPV positivity. These findings describe the regional epidemiology of HR-HPV infection in a cervical screening cohort from Leshan and support continued genotype surveillance, while conclusions regarding genotype replacement and vaccine impact should be interpreted with caution due to incomplete vaccination history data.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 高危人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染是宫颈癌前病变和宫颈癌的主要病因。本研究的重点是在中国乐山接受宫颈筛查的女性中 HR-HPV 类型及其与 宫颈癌 的关联。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项回顾性横断面研究评估了 2022 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间在中国四川省乐山市妇幼保健院接受常规 宫颈癌 筛查的女性的 HR-HPV 感染情况。总共纳入了 5,000 名年龄在 25-60 岁之间的合格女性。使用无菌细胞刷从转化区收集宫颈标本并保存在液基细胞学培养基中。主要 HR-HPV 检测使用 Roche Cobas 4800 HPV 检测进行,该检测可单独检测 HPV16 和 HPV18,并检测 12 种其他高危基因型作为汇总结果。通过巢式多重 PCR 进一步分析合并 HR-HPV 阳性的样本,以确定其他基因型。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在 5,000 名接受筛查的女性中,612 名 HR-HPV 呈阳性,相当于 患病率 的总体比例为 12.2%。HPV阳性病例中,单基因型感染占65.7%,多基因型感染占34.3%。HPV16 是最常见的基因型,其次是 HPV31、HPV56、HPV66 和 HPV51。HR-HPV 患病率 在 25-30 岁女性中最高,并随着年龄的增长而下降。多变量分析显示,年龄低于 35 岁、多个性伴侣、吸烟和缺乏事先筛查与 HR-HPV 阳性的几率较高相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 这些发现描述了乐山宫颈筛查 队列研究 中 HR-HPV 感染的区域 流行病学,并支持持续的基因型 监测,而由于 疫苗接种 历史数据不完整,有关基因型替换和 疫苗 影响的结论应谨慎解释。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: HR-HPV 监测 的区域 监测 和基因型分布很重要,因为循环基因型可能根据地理位置、年龄结构、筛查途径和 疫苗接种 覆盖范围而变化。

source_body_en: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is the principal etiological factor in cervical precancer and cervical cancer. Regional surveillance of HR-HPV prevalence and genotype distribution is important because circulating genotypes may vary according to geography, age structure, screening access, and vaccination coverage. This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated HR-HPV infection among women undergoing routine cervical cancer screening at Leshan Maternal and Child Health Hospital, Leshan, Sichuan, China, between January 2022 and December 2024. A total of 5,000 eligible women aged 25-60 years were included. Cervical specimens were collected from the transformation zone using a sterile cytobrush and preserved in liquid-based cytology medium. Primary HR-HPV detection was performed using the Roche Cobas 4800 HPV assay, which detects HPV16 and HPV18 individually and detects 12 additional high-risk genotypes as a pooled result. Samples positive for pooled HR-HPV were further analyzed by nested multiplex PCR to identify additional genotypes. Cytology and histopathology results, where available, were reviewed and correlated with HPV detection results. Among 5,000 screened women, 612 were HR-HPV positive, corresponding to an overall prevalence of 12.2%. Single-genotype infections accounted for 65.7% of HPV-positive cases, while multiple-genotype infections accounted for 34.3%. HPV16 was the most frequent genotype, followed by HPV31, HPV56, HPV66, and HPV51. HR-HPV prevalence was highest in women aged 25-30 years and declined with increasing age. Multivariate analysis showed that age below 35 years, multiple sexual partners, smoking, and lack of prior screening were associated with higher odds of HR-HPV positivity. These findings describe the regional epidemiology of HR-HPV infection in a cervical screening cohort from Leshan and support continued genotype surveillance, while conclusions regarding genotype replacement and vaccine impact should be interpreted with caution due to incomplete vaccination history data.

title: Comparative efficacy of topical garlic extract and 20% podophyllin solution in the treatment of female genital warts: a triple-blind randomized clinical trial.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Genital warts caused by human papillomavirus are common sexually transmitted infections, with no single therapy providing consistent clearance. Garlic extract has antiviral and antiproliferative properties and may offer a low-cost treatment. OBJECTIVE: To compare the efficacy and safety of topical 5% garlic extract with 20% podophyllin solution in women with genital warts. METHODS: Seventy-four women were randomized to 5% garlic extract (n = 37) or 20% podophyllin (n = 37), applied weekly for four weeks. Wart size and count were assessed using marginal models (generalized estimating equations). The primary outcome was change in mean wart size and the secondary outcome was change in wart count. RESULTS: Mean wart size decreased from 1.61 ± 0.81 to 0.60 ± 0.82 mm with garlic extract and from 2.96 ± 7.99 to 0.62 ± 0.73 mm with podophyllin. The between-group p-value at final assessment was 0.756; group × time interaction p values were 0.329 for wart size and 0.583 for count. Among 35 and 37 participants analyzed, complete response occurred in 18 (51.4%) and 19 (51.4%), respectively; complete or partial response occurred in 23 (65.7%) and 25 (67.6%). Itching and burning occurred in 8 (21.6%) garlic-treated participants each. CONCLUSION: Both treatments reduced wart size and count, with similar response rates. Four-week follow-up precluded assessment of durability and recurrence.

title_zh: 外用大蒜提取物和 20% 鬼臼素溶液对女性生殖器疣 治疗 的疗效比较:一项三盲随机临床试验。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Genital warts caused by human papillomavirus are common sexually transmitted infections, with no single therapy providing consistent clearance. Garlic extract has antiviral and antiproliferative properties and may offer a low-cost treatment. OBJECTIVE: To compare the efficacy and safety of topical 5% garlic extract with 20% podophyllin solution in women with genital warts. METHODS: Seventy-four women were randomized to 5% garlic extract (n = 37) or 20% podophyllin (n = 37), applied weekly for four weeks. Wart size and count were assessed using marginal models (generalized estimating equations). The primary outcome was change in mean wart size and the secondary outcome was change in wart count. RESULTS: Mean wart size decreased from 1.61 ± 0.81 to 0.60 ± 0.82 mm with garlic extract and from 2.96 ± 7.99 to 0.62 ± 0.73 mm with podophyllin. The between-group p-value at final assessment was 0.756; group × time interaction p values were 0.329 for wart size and 0.583 for count. Among 35 and 37 participants analyzed, complete response occurred in 18 (51.4%) and 19 (51.4%), respectively; complete or partial response occurred in 23 (65.7%) and 25 (67.6%). Itching and burning occurred in 8 (21.6%) garlic-treated participants each. CONCLUSION: Both treatments reduced wart size and count, with similar response rates. Four-week follow-up precluded assessment of durability and recurrence.
abstract_zh: 背景:由 人乳头瘤病毒 引起的尖锐湿疣是常见的性传播感染,没有单一疗法可以提供一致的清除效果。大蒜提取物具有 抗病毒药物 和抗增殖特性,并且可以提供低成本的 治疗。目的:比较外用 5% 大蒜提取物和 20% 鬼臼素溶液治疗女性尖锐湿疣的疗效和安全性。方法:74 名女性被随机分配使用 5% 大蒜提取物 (n = 37) 或 20% 鬼臼素 (n = 37),每周使用一次,持续四个星期。使用边际模型(广义估计方程)评估疣的大小和数量。主要结果是平均疣大小的变化,次要结果是疣数量的变化。结果:使用大蒜提取物后,疣的平均大小从 1.61 ± 0.81 毫米减少到 0.60 ± 0.82 毫米,使用鬼臼素时,疣平均大小从 2.96 ± 7.99 毫米减少到 0.62 ± 0.73 毫米。最终评估时的组间 p 值为 0.756;组×时间交互作用的疣大小 p 值为 0.329,计数 p 值为 0.583。在分析的 35 名和 37 名参与者中,分别有 18 名 (51.4%) 和 19 名 (51.4%) 出现完全缓解;23 例 (65.7%) 和 25 例 (67.6%) 出现完全或部分缓解。8 名(21.6%)接受大蒜治疗的参与者分别出现瘙痒和烧灼感。结论:治疗 均减少了疣的大小和数量,且反应率相似。四周的随访排除了对耐久性和复发的评估。

title: Beyond HPV16/18: genotype distribution of high-risk HPV and cycle threshold values in cervical carcinogenesis spectrum
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer is a virus-dependent gynaecologic malignancy and according to GLOBOCAN 2022 cervical cancer is the fourth frequent women cancer in all over the world. Despite this frequency it is rarely seen in developed countries because of the enforcement of cervical screening programmes with human papillomavirus (HPV) test and Pap test called cotest. The burden of this women cancer is high despite the implementation of HPV-based vaccines and screening strategies, could nearly eliminate cervical cancer as a public health problem. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted using non-16/18 high risk human papilloma virus (HR-HPV) genotyping data and cycle threshold (ct) values from women aged ≥18 years that underwent cervical sampling during gynaecological outpatient clinic at a tertiary centre in Turkey, between January 2022 and December 2023. RESULTS: The most frequently detected genotypes were HPV52 (n = 24), HPV31 (n = 23), HPV51 (n = 22) and HPV56 (n = 22). On the other hand in cervical intraepithelial neoplasia 3 (CIN3) cases, with combinations involving HPV51, HPV52, HPV59, HPV66 and HPV31 commonly detected. Median minimum patient-level Ct values were 22.0 (Interquartile range-IQR 8) in chronic cervicitis, 19.0 (IQR 10) in CIN1, 17.0 (IQR 8) in CIN2 and 19.0 (IQR 7) in CIN3. CONCLUSION: To the best of our knowledge, there are limited data about cycle threshold values in prediction of viral load. These region-specific, genotype-resolved data may inform extended-genotyping-based risk stratification and support ongoing surveillance of non-16/18 HR-HPV patterns within HPV-based screening programs. Hence this study opens a new perspective in this era.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈癌 是一种病毒依赖性妇科恶性肿瘤,根据 GLOBOCAN 2022,宫颈癌 是全球第四大常见女性癌症。尽管这种频率很高,但在发达国家却很少见到这种情况,因为它们实施了宫颈筛查计划,包括 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 测试和称为 cotest 的巴氏涂片测试。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间在土耳其三级中心妇科门诊接受宫颈采样的 18 岁以上女性的非 16/18 高危人乳头状瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 基因分型数据和周期阈值 (ct) 值进行回顾性分析。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究对 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间在土耳其一家三级中心收集的宫颈样本的 HR-HPV 基因分型数据和周期阈值 (ct) 进行了回顾性分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 最常检测到的基因型是 HPV52 (n = 24)、HPV31 (n = 23)、HPV51 (n = 22) 和 HPV56 (n = 22)。另一方面,在宫颈上皮内瘤变 3 (CIN3) 病例中,常见检测到 HPV51、HPV52、HPV59、HPV66 和 HPV31 的组合。慢性宫颈炎患者的中位最低患者水平 Ct 值为 22.0(四分位距 -IQR 8),CIN1 为 19.0(IQR 10),CIN2 为 17.0(IQR 8),CIN3 为 19.0(IQR 7)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究深入了解了非 16/18 高危型HPV 基因型的分布及其与宫颈癌发生不同阶段的关联,强调了周期阈值在预测病毒载量方面的潜在作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些区域特异性、基因型解析的数据可以为基于扩展基因分型的风险分层提供信息,并支持基于 HPV 筛查计划中正在进行的非 16/18 HR-HPV 模式的 监测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,可能会受到此类设计固有的偏差的影响。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它提供了不同宫颈疾病阶段的详细基因型分布和周期阈值。

title: Evolving Roles in Decision-Making About Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Among Middle School Girls in Yinzhou of Ningbo, Eastern China: A Qualitative Study With a Focus on the Educational Sector as an Influential Player
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is endorsed by the World Health Organization for cervical cancer prevention, but it is not part of China’s national immunization program. This study explores the roles of various key interest holders in HPV vaccination decisions, focusing on a local pilot program in Yinzhou, Ningbo, eastern China, targeting first-year middle school girls. Data were collected from October 18 to November 14, 2023, using literature and policy reviews and in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with local key interest holders. Thematic analysis was performed using a Social Ecological Model (SEM) to identify determinants influencing HPV vaccination decisions across five levels. A total of 55 participants were interviewed. The results showed that the educational sector worked closely with health authorities in the program’s design and implementation. Middle schools and teachers played a significant role in influencing both parents and students, despite limited direct benefits. At the interpersonal level, educators disseminated vaccine-related information and guided parents and students. At the organizational level, the collaboration between the educational and health sectors, as well as between teachers and health care professionals, strongly influenced decision-making. At the community level, health education provided to teachers extended to parents and students, enhancing awareness and support. The findings highlight the crucial role of educational sectors in promoting HPV vaccination and emphasize the importance of positive support from schools and effective partnerships with other key stakeholders. These insights may be applicable to other socioeconomically advanced regions in China considering similar HPV vaccination initiatives.

source_records.title: Evolving Roles in Decision-Making About Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Among Middle School Girls in Yinzhou of Ningbo, Eastern China: A Qualitative Study With a Focus on the Educational Sector as an Influential Player
source_records.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is endorsed by the World Health Organization for cervical cancer prevention, but it is not part of China’s national immunization program. This study explores the roles of various key interest holders in HPV vaccination decisions, focusing on a local pilot program in Yinzhou, Ningbo, eastern China, targeting first-year middle school girls. Data were collected from October 18 to November 14, 2023, using literature and policy reviews and in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with local key interest holders. Thematic analysis was performed using a Social Ecological Model (SEM) to identify determinants influencing HPV vaccination decisions across five levels. A total of 55 participants were interviewed. The results showed that the educational sector worked closely with health authorities in the program’s design and implementation. Middle schools and teachers played a significant role in influencing both parents and students, despite limited direct benefits. At the interpersonal level, educators disseminated vaccine-related information and guided parents and students. At the organizational level, the collaboration between the educational and health sectors, as well as between teachers and health care professionals, strongly influenced decision-making. At the community level, health education provided to teachers extended to parents and students, enhancing awareness and support. The findings highlight the crucial role of educational sectors in promoting HPV vaccination and emphasize the importance of positive support from schools and effective partnerships with other key stakeholders. These insights may be applicable to other socioeconomically advanced regions in China considering similar HPV vaccination initiatives.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 得到世界卫生组织认可用于 宫颈癌 预防,但不属于中国国家免疫规划的一部分。本研究探讨了不同关键利益相关者在 HPV 疫苗接种 决策中的作用,重点关注中国东部宁波市鄞州的一个针对初中一年级女生的当地试点项目。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 数据收集于 2023 年 10 月 18 日至 11 月 14 日,通过文献和政策回顾以及与当地主要利益相关者的深入访谈和焦点小组讨论。使用社会生态模型 (SEM) 进行主题分析,以确定影响 HPV 疫苗接种 五个级别决策的决定因素。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 结果表明,教育部门在该计划的设计和实施过程中与卫生当局密切合作。尽管直接效益有限,但中学和教师在影响家长和学生方面发挥了重要作用。在人际层面,教育工作者传播疫苗相关信息,并对家长和学生进行引导。在组织层面,教育和卫生部门之间以及教师和医疗保健专业人员之间的合作对决策产生了强烈影响。在社区层面,向教师提供的健康教育延伸至家长和学生,提高了认识和支持。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 研究结果强调了教育部门在促进 HPV 疫苗接种 方面的关键作用,并强调了学校积极支持以及与其他主要利益相关者建立有效伙伴关系的重要性。这些见解可能适用于考虑类似 HPV 疫苗接种 举措的中国其他社会经济发达地区。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究表明,教育部门在 HPV 疫苗接种 计划中发挥着重要作用。未来的研究应侧重于了解教育部门为增强家长和学生对 疫苗 的吸收和支持而采用的具体机制和策略。实际影响包括教育和卫生部门之间需要继续合作,以确保 HPV 疫苗接种 计划的有效实施。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 结果表明,教育部门在该计划的设计和实施过程中与卫生当局密切合作。尽管直接效益有限,但中学和教师在影响家长和学生方面发挥了重要作用。在人际层面,教育工作者传播疫苗相关信息,并对家长和学生进行引导。在组织层面,教育和卫生部门之间以及教师和医疗保健专业人员之间的合作对决策产生了强烈影响。在社区层面,向教师提供的健康教育延伸至家长和学生,提高了认识和支持。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 研究结果强调了教育部门在促进 HPV 疫苗接种 方面的关键作用,并强调了学校积极支持以及与其他主要利益相关者建立有效伙伴关系的重要性。这些见解可能适用于考虑类似 HPV 疫苗接种 举措的中国其他社会经济发达地区。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究表明,教育部门在 HPV 疫苗接种 计划中发挥着重要作用。未来的研究应侧重于了解教育部门为增强家长和学生对 疫苗 的吸收和支持而采用的具体机制和策略。实际影响包括教育和卫生部门之间需要继续合作,以确保 HPV 疫苗接种 计划的有效实施。

title: Controlled Trial of Cervical Cancer Screening Frequency Among Human Papillomavirus Vaccinated Women II : Cervical Pre‐Cancer End‐Points by Specific Non‐Vaccine HPV Types
abstract: ABSTRACT We conducted a controlled trial among 5626 early adolescent women vaccinated in 2007–2009 against human papillomavirus (HPV) types 16/18 to evaluate the impact of high‐intensity versus low‐intensity cervical screening, respectively at ages 22/25/28 and 28 years with squamous‐cell intraepithelial lesions (SILs) as the end‐point. Over the 16‐year follow‐up, most of the cytologically and/or histologically confirmed low‐grade and high‐grade SILs were associated with non‐vaccine‐targeted, medium oncogenicity HPV types 33/35/52/58 belonging to clade A9. The low‐intensity cervical screening was non‐inferior to the high‐intensity screening in the identification of these lesions. Possibly, the transition from cervical infections with vaccine‐covered HPV types to infections with non‐vaccine‐covered HPV types contributes to more manageable occurrence of the screen‐detected cervical lesions. Reduction of cervical screening among vaccinated women to a minimum may be warranted to balance the harm—benefit ratio of screening.

title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种女性中 宫颈癌 筛查频率的对照试验 II:特定非 疫苗 HPV 类型的宫颈癌前终点
source_body_en: ABSTRACT We conducted a controlled trial among 5626 early adolescent women vaccinated in 2007–2009 against human papillomavirus (HPV) types 16/18 to evaluate the impact of high‐intensity versus low‐intensity cervical screening, respectively at ages 22/25/28 and 28 years with squamous‐cell intraepithelial lesions (SILs) as the end‐point. Over the 16‐year follow‐up, most of the cytologically and/or histologically confirmed low‐grade and high‐grade SILs were associated with non‐vaccine‐targeted, medium oncogenicity HPV types 33/35/52/58 belonging to clade A9. The low‐intensity cervical screening was non‐inferior to the high‐intensity screening in the identification of these lesions. Possibly, the transition from cervical infections with vaccine‐covered HPV types to infections with non‐vaccine‐covered HPV types contributes to more manageable occurrence of the screen‐detected cervical lesions. Reduction of cervical screening among vaccinated women to a minimum may be warranted to balance the harm—benefit ratio of screening.

title: Three-year persistence and clearance patterns of high-risk HPV genotype groups among women in Chirchik, Uzbekistan: A secondary analysis of a pilot screening study
abstract: Abstract Background High-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) persistence is central to cervical carcinogenesis, yet longitudinal data from Central Asia remain limited. This secondary analysis assessed the distribution of hrHPV genotype groups and 3-year follow-up patterns among women in Chirchik, Uzbekistan. Methods From August 2021 to March 2022, 5,678 women were screened for hrHPV, of whom 547 (9.6%) tested positive. HPV genotyping was performed using the Xpert HPV assay. Single infections were defined as the detection of one genotype group, while multiple infections were defined as the detection of two or more groups. Clearance was defined as the loss of HPV16 (P1) at follow-up, regardless of the status of other genotypes. Results Single infections predominated at baseline (87.0%, 476/547), while double, triple, and quadruple infections accounted for 11.2%, 1.6%, and 0.2% of cases, respectively. The most frequently detected genotype groups were HPV16 (29.8%), HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.9%), and HPV39/56/66/68 (16.5%). At 3-year follow-up, 409 baseline hrHPV-positive women were re-evaluated, and 108 remained hrHPV-positive. Single infections remained predominant among persistent hrHPV-positive cases (94.4%, 102/108). HPV16 was the most frequently detected genotype group at follow-up (38.0%), followed by HPV39/56/66/68 (24.1%) and HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.4%). Newly detected genotype groups were observed in 36 women, with HPV39/56/66/68 being the most common (52.8%). Among women with HPV16 at baseline, clearance was observed in 66.9% (83/124) of those with single HPV16 infection, 77.8% of those with HPV16 + HPV31/33/35/52/58 (7/9) co-infection, and 83.3% of HPV16 + HPV39/56/66/68 (5/6) co-infection. A Fisher’s exact test showed no statistically significant difference in clearance proportions between the three groups (p = 0.740). Conclusion This secondary analysis provides preliminary evidence on the distribution of hrHPV genotype groups and 3-year follow-up patterns in Uzbekistan. Larger studies with repeated follow-up testing and genotype-level analysis are needed to confirm these findings.

title: The assembly pathway for human papillomavirus L1 capsid protein is encoded in electrostatic interactions
abstract: Abstract Human papillomavirus L1 protein spontaneously folds and assembles into 60 nm virus‐like particles (VLP), with T = 7d icosahedral symmetry at high salt concentrations but not in low salt. Rapid increase from low to high salt during the assembly process gives poor‐quality VLPs, while slowly increasing salt, over as many as 48 h, gives rise to high‐quality VLPs. Insight into this behavior is drawn from a computational model based on the cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo‐EM) structure of the human papillomavirus Type 16 VLP. Electrostatic potential energy barriers were calculated using the linearized Poisson–Boltzmann equation. After initial, rapid oligomerization of monomers into symmetrical pentamers (capsomeres), these units form pairwise interactions in energetic order, lowest barrier first. But at high salt concentrations, the energetic barriers are more or less equal and irregular particles form, both in simulation and in experiments. The interaction interfaces were modified by mutation to favor the smaller, 30 nm T = 1 icosahedral symmetry and disfavor T = 7d symmetry. The results were smaller particles. By carefully controlling ionic strength, and/or by mutating interface residues by design, it is possible to make high quality, highly immunogenic VLPs directly from unpurified bacterial lysate, without requiring the use of a disassembly/reassembly step.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the assembly pathway of human papillomavirus (HPV) L1 capsid protein and how salt concentration affects the formation of virus-like particles (VLPs). This is important for developing high-quality VLPs for vaccine applications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a computational model based on the cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of the human papillomavirus Type 16 VLP. It involved simulating the assembly process under varying salt concentrations and analyzing the resulting structures.
analysis.methods: The researchers calculated electrostatic potential energy barriers using the linearized Poisson–Boltzmann equation. They also modified interaction interfaces through mutation to favor specific symmetries and observed the outcomes of these changes.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that when salt concentration increases rapidly, poor-quality VLPs form, while a slow increase over 48 hours leads to high-quality VLPs. Mutations were found to favor smaller, 30 nm T = 1 icosahedral symmetry over T = 7d symmetry.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the assembly pathway is governed by electrostatic interactions and that controlling ionic strength or mutating specific residues can lead to the formation of high-quality, immunogenic VLPs directly from bacterial lysate.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform the development of more efficient methods for producing HPV VLPs for vaccines, potentially eliminating the need for disassembly and reassembly steps.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to computational models and does not include experimental validation beyond the initial observations. The evidence is moderate as it relies on simulations and controlled mutations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the assembly pathway of human papillomavirus (HPV) L1 capsid protein, focusing on how salt concentration influences the formation of virus-like particles (VLPs). The research highlights that rapid salt increases lead to poor-quality VLPs, while slow increases produce high-quality ones. Using a computational model based on the cryo-EM structure of HPV Type 16 VLPs, the authors calculated electrostatic potential energy barriers and modified interaction interfaces through mutation to favor specific symmetries. The results suggest that controlling ionic strength or mutating residues can enhance VLP quality, offering potential improvements for vaccine development. However, the study relies on simulations and lacks experimental validation, limiting the strength of the evidence to moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) L1 衣壳蛋白的组装途径以及盐浓度如何影响病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 的形成。这对于为 疫苗 应用开发高质量的 VLP 非常重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了基于 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型 VLP 低温电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构的计算模型。它涉及模拟不同盐浓度下的组装过程并分析所得结构。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用线性化泊松-玻尔兹曼方程计算静电势能垒。他们还通过 突变 修改了交互界面以支持特定的对称性,并观察了这些变化的结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,当盐浓度快速增加时,会形成质量较差的VLP,而在48小时内缓慢增加会形成高质量的VLP。发现 突变 更倾向于较小的 30 nm T = 1 二十面体对称性,而不是 T = 7d 对称性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,组装途径受静电相互作用控制,控制离子强度或突变特定残基可以导致直接从细菌裂解物中形成高质量、免疫原性的 VLP。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效的方法来生产 疫苗 的 HPV VLP 提供信息,从而有可能消除拆卸和重新组装步骤的需要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于计算模型,不包括超出初始观察结果的实验​​验证。证据是中等的,因为它依赖于模拟和受控的 突变。

abstract_zh: 摘要 人乳头瘤病毒 L1 蛋白在高盐浓度下自发折叠并组装成 60 nm 病毒样颗粒(VLP),具有 T = 7d 二十面体对称性,但在低盐浓度下则不然。在组装过程中从低盐到高盐的快速增加会产生质量较差的 VLP,而在长达 48 小时内缓慢增加盐会产生高质量的 VLP。对这种行为的深入了解是通过基于 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型 VLP 低温电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构的计算模型得出的。使用线性化泊松-玻尔兹曼方程计算静电势能垒。在单体最初快速寡聚成对称五聚体(壳粒)后,这些单元以能量顺序形成成对相互作用,最低势垒首先。但在高盐浓度下,无论是在模拟还是在实验中,能量势垒或多或少都是相等的,并且粒子形式不规则。相互作用界面由 突变 修改,以支持更小的 30 nm T = 1 二十面体对称性,而不支持 T = 7d 对称性。结果是更小的颗粒。通过仔细控制离子强度和/或通过设计突变界面残基,可以直接从未纯化的细菌裂解物中制备高质量、高免疫原性的VLP,而不需要使用拆卸/重新组装步骤。

title: The effect of mindfulness-based counseling on shame in women with human papillomavirus
abstract: This study evaluated the impact of mindfulness-based counseling on shame in women with Human Papillomavirus (HPV), addressing the gap in standardized mental health support and the often-overlooked emotional distress in HPV care. This randomized controlled trial was conducted in 2024 at Ayatollah Mousavi Hospital in Zanjan, Iran. Participants were recruited during routine visits and randomly assigned to intervention or control groups (70 per group) using block randomization. The intervention group received standard care plus eight weekly 90-minute mindfulness-based group counseling sessions (one in-person, seven virtual). The control group received standard medical care and health education. External shame was measured using Goss et al.'s Questionnaire. Data were analysed using independent- and paired-samples t-tests and baseline-adjusted ANCOVA, with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant. No significant baseline difference was observed between groups. After adjustment for baseline external shame, ANCOVA showed significantly lower post-intervention scores in the intervention group than in the control group (F = 56.03, p < 0.001, partial η2 = 0.292). Paired-samples t-tests showed significant within-group reductions in both the intervention (p < 0.001) and control (p = 0.011) groups (p < 0.001). These findings suggest that mindfulness-based counseling may have potential as a supportive psychosocial component of HPV care. Further research with longer follow-up periods and culturally sensitive approaches is needed to examine the durability of these findings and their applicability across diverse healthcare settings.

title: Knowledge about Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Infection among Adolescent Girls in a Selected Girls School in Enayetpur, Sirajganj
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a common sexually transmitted infection and the leading cause of cervical cancer globally. In Bangladesh, cervical cancer remains a major public health concern, and HPV vaccination has been introduced to reduce disease burden. Despite vaccination programs, awareness and knowledge about HPV infection and prevention among adolescents remain variable. Objective(s): To assess the knowledge about HPV infection, its transmission, associated diseases, and preventive measures, including vaccination, among adolescent girls in a selected girls’ school in Enayetpur, Sirajganj, Bangladesh. Materials and methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted at Meher-Un-Nessa Girls’ High School, Enayetpur, from July to December 2024. A total of 130 students from classes VIII, IX, and X were selected using convenience sampling. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews using a semi-structured questionnaire and analyzed using SPSS version 27. Findings were presented using tables and graphs. Results: The majority of respondents were 14–15 years old (83.8%) and predominantly from nuclear families (68.5%). Most respondents (77.7%) correctly identified cervical cancer as an HPV-related disease, though misconceptions were present, such as 67.7% incorrectly mentioning cold and cough. Regarding HPV transmission, 52.3% identified sexual contact, while 66.2% mentioned physical touch. Awareness of the HPV vaccine was high (97.7%), but only 41.5% reported having received it. Concerning prevention, 84.6% recognized vaccination, 76.2% mentioned health education, and 50.0% cited safe behavior, while 17.7% did not know preventive measures. Conclusion: Adolescent girls in this school had reasonable awareness of HPV infection and vaccination but demonstrated gaps in knowledge regarding transmission and preventive behaviors. Targeted school-based health education programs emphasizing accurate information and vaccine uptake are recommended to reduce future HPV-related disease burden in Bangladesh. KYANCJ 2026; 07 (01): 12-16

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 7 月至 12 月,在 Enayetpur Meher-Un-Nessa 女子高中进行了一项描述性横断面研究,涉及 VIII、IX 和 X 年级的 130 名学生,通过便利抽样进行选择。
elements_zh.methods: 使用半结构化问卷通过面对面访谈收集数据,并使用 SPSS 27 版进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 大多数受访者 (83.8%) 年龄在 14-15 岁,来自核心家庭 (68.5%)。大多数受访者 (77.7%) 正确地将 宫颈癌 识别为 HPV 相关疾病,但存在误解。对于传播,52.3%的人提到了性接触,而66.2%的人提到了身体接触。对 HPV 疫苗 的认知度很高 (97.7%),但只有 41.5% 的人接受过该疫苗。在预防方面,84.6%的人认可“疫苗接种”,76.2%的人提到健康教育,50.0%的人提到安全行为,而17.7%的人不知道预防措施。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,青春期女孩对 HPV 感染和 传播 的认识合理,但强调了在 传播 和预防行为方面的知识差距。研究结果表明需要有针对性的基于学校的健康教育计划。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为制定有针对性的健康教育计划提供信息,以提高对 HPV 疫苗接种 的认识和吸收,从而减少孟加拉国未来与 HPV 相关的疾病负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究使用便利抽样可能会引入选择偏差,并且研究结果可能无法推广到孟加拉国更广泛的青春期女孩群体。证据强度中等。

title: Human papillomavirus prevalence and genotype distribution in a community-based sample of ever-married women in the Mekong Delta, Vietnam: a multistage cross-sectional study
abstract: Abstract Background Community-based HPV genotype data remain limited in southern Vietnam, where screening programmes must interpret genotype-specific risk in a population with low documented HPV vaccination. We described HPV prevalence, IARC Group 1 carcinogenic genotype distribution, infection multiplicity, and woman-level detection of HPV16/18 and of at least one genotype included in the nonavalent vaccine. Methods From January to June 2026, we conducted a community-based cross-sectional study among 1,193 enrolled ever-married women aged 25–65 years in Ca Mau Province, Vietnam; the response-rate denominator was 1,565 women, yielding a response rate of 76.2%. A three-stage sampling design with random selection procedures was used. Because stage-specific selection probabilities were unavailable, prevalence estimates are reported as unweighted descriptive proportions. Cervical specimens were tested by real-time PCR for 23 HPV genotypes, and cervical cytology was performed concurrently. Crude proportions and Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs) calculated under a simple-random-sampling assumption are reported; no inferential comparisons were performed. Results Crude, unweighted HPV prevalence was 7.1% (85/1,193; 95% CI 5.8–8.7); all 85 had a retrievable genotype result. Overall, 78 (91.8%) carried at least one manufacturer-designated high-risk genotype and 66 (77.6%) carried an IARC Group 1 carcinogenic genotype. HPV52 (20/85, 23.5%) and HPV58 (14/85, 16.5%) were the most frequently detected genotypes, followed by HPV16, HPV51 and HPV59 (each 10/85, 11.8%) and HPV18 (4/85, 4.7%); genotype frequencies were not compared statistically. Multiple genotypes were detected in 25/85 HPV-positive women (29.4%). Among women with an IARC Group 1 genotype, 52/66 (78.8%) had neither HPV16 nor HPV18. At least one nonavalent-vaccine genotype was detected in 50/85 HPV-positive women (58.8%). Conclusions Overall HPV prevalence was low, HPV52 and HPV58 were the most frequently detected genotypes, and nearly four in five women with an IARC Group 1 carcinogenic genotype carried neither HPV16 nor HPV18. Because stage-specific selection probabilities were unavailable, these are unweighted descriptive estimates for the study sample rather than design-based estimates for Ca Mau Province. They describe the baseline genotype distribution in a population with low documented HPV vaccination. Genotype frequency should not be translated into local triage policy without longitudinal evidence linking individual types to histologically confirmed precancer and cancer.

title: Distribution of high-risk human papillomavirus genotypes and associated risk factors among women with normal and abnormal cervical cytology in Lagos, Nigeria
abstract: Cervical cancer is the fourth most common cancer in women worldwide and is primarily driven by persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) genotypes. This study aimed to determine HR-HPV genotype distribution and associated risk factors in women with normal and abnormal cervical cytology in Lagos, Nigeria. A total of 165 sexually active women were recruited from a tertiary gynecology referral clinic between July 2017 and June 2018. Cervical cytology was assessed using Pap smears, whereas HR-HPV was detected and genotyped using nested and multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR) targeting 18 HR-HPV genotypes (13 established and 5 probable high-risk types). Sociodemographic and clinical data were collected via questionnaires and analyzed using SPSS version 21. Associations between HR-HPV prevalence and risk factors were evaluated using chi-square and logistic regression analyses. Factors independently associated with HR-HPV infection were subsequently identified using multivariable logistic regression with Firth’s penalized-likelihood method. Among the 165 participants, 93 (56.4%) were positive for at least one of the 13 established high-risk HPV genotypes, while 116 (70.3%) were positive for at least one of the 18 tested established or probable high-risk HPV genotypes, with HPV-35 emerging as the predominant genotype (43.6%), followed by HPV-82 (20.0%), and HPV-73 (9.1%). Among women with abnormal cytology (21.8%), HPV-35 was the most frequent genotype across all cytological grades. Dual and multiple HR-HPV infections were common, occurring in 34.5% of all participants. History of sexually transmitted infection was significantly associated with HR-HPV infection (OR, 2.97; 95% CI 1.43–6.17; P = 0.003); later sexual debut (≥ 21 years) and a higher number of lifetime sexual partners showed elevated but not statistically significant odds ratios. After multivariable adjustment, condom use (adjusted odds ratio [AOR], 0.19; 95% CI 0.08–0.45; P < 0.001) and history of sexually transmitted infection (AOR, 3.27; 95% CI 1.47–7.25; P = 0.004) remained independently associated with HR-HPV infection, whereas age, educational status, and marital status did not. This study revealed a high burden of HR-HPV among women in Lagos, with a predominance of genotypes not covered by current HPV vaccines. These findings underscore the urgent need for region-specific vaccine strategies, the integration of molecular diagnostics into routine screening, and targeted public health interventions to reduce HPV disease.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the distribution of high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) genotypes and their associated risk factors among women with normal and abnormal cervical cytology in Lagos, Nigeria. The research aimed to address the burden of cervical cancer, which is driven by persistent HR-HPV infection. A total of 165 women were recruited between 2017 and 2018, and HR-HPV was detected using PCR targeting 18 genotypes. The study found that 93 women were positive for at least one of the 13 established HR-HPV genotypes, and 116 were positive for the 18 tested genotypes, with HPV-35 being the most prevalent. The findings highlight the need for region-specific vaccine strategies and improved screening methods, as many prevalent genotypes are not covered by current vaccines. The study's results are based on a relatively small sample size and may have limited generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈癌 是全球女性中第四大常见癌症,主要由高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 基因型持续感染引起。本研究旨在确定尼日利亚拉各斯宫颈细胞学检查正常和异常的女性的 HR-HPV 基因型分布和相关危险因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2017 年 7 月至 2018 年 6 月期间,从三级妇科转诊诊所招募了总共 165 名性活跃女性。在 165 名参与者中,93 名参与者 (56.4%) 对 13 种已确定的 高危型HPV 基因型中的至少一种呈阳性,而 116 名 (70.3%) 对 18 种测试的已确定或可能的基因型中的至少一种呈阳性高危型HPV 基因型。
elements_zh.methods: 使用巴氏涂片评估宫颈细胞学,而使用针对 18 个 HR-HPV 基因型的巢式多重聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 检测 HR-HPV 并进行基因分型。通过问卷收集社会人口学和临床数据,并使用 SPSS 21 版进行分析。使用卡方和逻辑回归分析评估 HR-HPV 患病率 与危险因素之间的关联。随后使用多变量逻辑回归和 Firth 惩罚似然法确定了与 HR-HPV 感染独立相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 性传播感染史与高危型HPV感染显著相关(OR 2.97;95% CI 1.43–6.17;P = 0.003);较晚的首次性行为(≥21岁)以及更高的终生性伴侣数量显示出升高但未达统计学显著的比值比。多变量校正后,使用安全套(校正后比值比 [AOR] 0.19;95% CI 0.08–0.45;P < 0.001)和性传播感染史(AOR 3.27;95% CI 1.47–7.25;P = 0.004)仍然与高危型HPV感染独立相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究揭示了拉各斯女性的 HR-HPV 负担较高,其中大部分基因型未被当前 HPV 疫苗 涵盖。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调迫切需要针对特定​​区域的 疫苗 策略、将分子诊断纳入常规筛查以及有针对性的公共卫生干预措施以减少 HPV 疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告研究设计的局限性或证据的强度。

Dual and multiple HR-HPV infections were common, occurring in 34.5% of all participants. History of sexually transmitted infection was significantly associated with HR-HPV infection (OR, 2.97; 95% CI 1.43–6.17; P = 0.003); later sexual debut (≥ 21 years) and a higher number of lifetime sexual partners showed elevated but not statistically significant odds ratios. After multivariable adjustment, condom use (adjusted odds ratio [AOR], 0.19; 95% CI 0.08–0.45; P < 0.001) and history of sexually transmitted infection (AOR, 3.27; 95% CI 1.47–7.25; P = 0.004) remained independently associated with HR-HPV infection, whereas age, educational status, and marital status did not. This study revealed a high burden of HR-HPV among women in Lagos, with a predominance of genotypes not covered by current HPV vaccines. These findings underscore the urgent need for region-specific vaccine strategies, the integration of molecular diagnostics into routine screening, and targeted public health interventions to reduce HPV disease.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈癌 是全球女性中第四大常见癌症,主要由高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 基因型持续感染引起。本研究旨在确定尼日利亚拉各斯宫颈细胞学检查正常和异常的女性的 HR-HPV 基因型分布和相关危险因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2017 年 7 月至 2018 年 6 月期间,从三级妇科转诊诊所招募了总共 165 名性活跃女性。在 165 名参与者中,93 名参与者 (56.4%) 对 13 种已确定的 高危型HPV 基因型中的至少一种呈阳性,而 116 名 (70.3%) 对 18 种测试的已确定或可能的基因型中的至少一种呈阳性高危型HPV 基因型。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用巴氏涂片评估宫颈细胞学,而使用针对 18 个 HR-HPV 基因型的巢式多重聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 检测 HR-HPV 并进行基因分型。通过问卷收集社会人口学和临床数据,并使用 SPSS 21 版进行分析。使用卡方和逻辑回归分析评估 HR-HPV 患病率 与危险因素之间的关联。随后使用多变量逻辑回归和 Firth 惩罚似然法确定了与 HR-HPV 感染独立相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 性传播感染史与高危型HPV感染显著相关(OR 2.97;95% CI 1.43–6.17;P = 0.003);较晚的首次性行为(≥21岁)以及更高的终生性伴侣数量显示出升高但未达统计学显著的比值比。多变量校正后,使用安全套(校正后比值比 [AOR] 0.19;95% CI 0.08–0.45;P < 0.001)和性传播感染史(AOR 3.27;95% CI 1.47–7.25;P = 0.004)仍然与高危型HPV感染独立相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究揭示了拉各斯女性的 HR-HPV 负担较高,其中大部分基因型未被当前 HPV 疫苗 涵盖。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调迫切需要针对特定​​区域的 疫苗 策略、将分子诊断纳入常规筛查以及有针对性的公共卫生干预措施以减少 HPV 疾病。

title: Validation of Immunoscore for Prognostic Stratification in HPV-associated Oropharyngeal Cancer: An International Multicenter Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: Optimizing treatment in HPV-associated OPSCC remains challenging, as current TNM- and smoking-based risk stratification inadequately captures tumor biological heterogeneity, highlighting the need for more prognostic biomarkers. We report the first validation of the Immunoscore (IS) in HPV-associated OPSCC. EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN: We analyzed 191 HPV-associated (p16+ and HPV DNA/RNA+) OPSCC patients from an international multicenter cohort (2015-2024), including a French monocentric retrospective training cohort (n = 48) and three validation cohorts: French monocentric retrospective (n = 48), French multicenter prospective (n = 50), and US multicenter retrospective (n = 45). IS quantified CD3+ and CD8+ densities in tumor cores and invasive margins, with cut-offs defined in the training cohort and validated across cohorts. Associations with disease-free survival (DFS), overall survival (OS), and time to recurrence (TTR) were assessed, alongside 3'RNA-seq and sequential immunofluorescence profiling. RESULTS: Median age 65; 80% male; 74% smokers; 66% T1-2; 82% N0-1. IS-High patients had superior 3-year DFS across cohorts (all log-rank P < .05). Multivariable analysis identified IS-Low as the independent prognostic factor with the largest adjusted effect size for DFS (HR 9.03; 95% CI: 4.02-20.31; P < .001). The combined IS-clinical model showed better DFS prediction than the clinical-only model (C-index 0.82 vs 0.70; P < .0001). Similar results were observed for TTR and OS. IS-High tumors showed enriched lymphoid and myeloid populations, contrasting with immune-poor IS-Low tumors. CONCLUSIONS: IS outperformed clinical variables in prognostic performance. By identifying biologically distinct risk groups, IS may enable biomarker-guided, risk-adapted treatment strategies, including treatment de-escalation and intensification.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Optimizing treatment in HPV‐associated oropharyngeal cancer remains challenging because current TNM‐ and smoking‐based risk stratification fails to capture tumor biological heterogeneity, creating a need for better prognostic biomarkers; this study aimed to validate the Immunoscore as such a biomarker.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was an international multicenter validation of Immunoscore in 191 HPV‐associated (p16+ and HPV DNA/RNA+) OPSCC patients (2015‐2024), comprising a French monocentric retrospective training cohort (n=48) and three validation cohorts (French retrospective n=48, French prospective n=50, US retrospective n=45), with IS quantified by CD3+ and CD8+ densities in tumor cores and invasive margins using cut‐offs defined in the training cohort and validated across cohorts.
analysis.methods: Immunoscore was measured by flow cytometry assessing CD3+ and CD8+ cell densities in tumor cores and invasive margins, and disease‐free survival, overall survival and time to recurrence were defined as primary outcomes; associations were evaluated with multivariable Cox models and C‐index comparison.
analysis.main_results: Median patient age was 65 with 80% male, 74% smokers, 66% T1‐2 and 82% N0‐1; IS‐High patients exhibited significantly higher 3‐year disease‐free survival (log‐rank P < .05), and IS‐Low was an independent prognostic factor for DFS with HR 9.03 (95% CI 4.02‐20.31; P < .001); the combined IS‐clinical model improved DFS prediction (C‐index 0.82 vs 0.70; P < .0001) and similar gains were observed for time to recurrence and overall survival, while IS‐High tumors showed enriched lymphoid and myeloid populations compared with immune‐poor IS‐Low tumors.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that Immunoscore outperformed clinical variables in prognostic performance and identified biologically distinct risk groups that may enable biomarker‐guided, risk‐adapted treatment strategies, representing the first validation of Immunoscore in HPV‐associated oropharyngeal cancer.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that Immunoscore can be used to stratify patients for risk‐adapted therapy, potentially improving clinical decision‐making and outcomes in HPV‐associated oropharyngeal cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on retrospective and prospective cohorts from limited geographic regions and cut‐offs derived from a single training cohort, together with the fact that the evidence is abstract‐only, limits confidence, but the multicenter design and large sample size provide moderate evidence strength.

analysis.summary_en: This international multicenter validation of Immunoscore in 191 HPV‐associated oropharyngeal cancer patients demonstrates that the Immunoscore outperforms clinical variables in prognostic performance, identifies distinct biological risk groups, and improves disease‐free survival prediction, supporting its potential use for risk‐adapted treatment decisions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在 HPV 相关口咽癌中优化 治疗 仍然具有挑战性,因为当前基于 TNM 和吸烟的风险分层无法捕获肿瘤的生物异质性,因此需要更好的预后生物标志物;本研究旨在验证免疫评分作为这样的生物标志物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对 191 名 HPV 相关(p16+ 和 HPV DNA/RNA+)OPSCC 患者(2015-2024 年)进行的免疫评分国际多中心验证,包括一项法国单中心回顾性训练 队列研究 (n=48) 和三项验证 队列研究(法国回顾性 n=48、法国前瞻性 n=50、美国回顾性 n=45),其中 IS使用训练 队列研究 中定义的截止值通过肿瘤核心和侵袭性边缘中的 CD3+ 和 CD8+ 密度进行量化,并在 队列研究 中进行验证。
elements_zh.methods: 通过流式细胞术测量免疫评分,评估肿瘤核心和浸润边缘的 CD3+ 和 CD8+ 细胞密度,并将无病生存期、总生存期和复发时间定义为主要结局;通过多变量 Cox 模型和 C 指数比较来评估关联性。
elements_zh.main_results: 中位患者年龄为65岁,其中80%为男性,74%为吸烟者,66%为T1‐2期,82%为N0‐1期;IS‐High患者表现出显著更高的3年无病生存率(log‐rank P < .05),且IS‐Low是无病生存期(DFS)的独立预后因素,其风险比(HR)为9.03(95%置信区间4.02‐20.31;P < .001);结合IS‐临床模型可改善DFS预测(C‐指数0.82 vs 0.70;P < .0001),且在复发时间及总生存期的预测中也观察到类似改善,而IS‐High肿瘤相较于免疫贫乏的IS‐Low肿瘤表现出更丰富的淋巴样和髓样细胞群体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,Immunoscore 在预后表现方面优于临床变量,并确定了生物学上不同的风险组,这些风险组可能能够实现生物标志物引导、风险适应的 治疗 策略,这代表了免疫评分在 HPV 相关口咽癌中的首次验证。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,免疫评分可用于对患者进行风险适应治疗分层,有可能改善 HPV 相关口咽癌的临床决策和结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于来自有限地理区域的回顾性和前瞻性 队列研究 以及来自单一训练 队列研究 的截止值,再加上证据仅是抽象的事实,限制了置信度,但多中心设计和大样本量提供了中等的证据强度。

Multivariable analysis identified IS-Low as the independent prognostic factor with the largest adjusted effect size for DFS (HR 9.03; 95% CI: 4.02-20.31; P < .001). The combined IS-clinical model showed better DFS prediction than the clinical-only model (C-index 0.82 vs 0.70; P < .0001). Similar results were observed for TTR and OS. IS-High tumors showed enriched lymphoid and myeloid populations, contrasting with immune-poor IS-Low tumors. CONCLUSIONS: IS outperformed clinical variables in prognostic performance. By identifying biologically distinct risk groups, IS may enable biomarker-guided, risk-adapted treatment strategies, including treatment de-escalation and intensification.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 在 HPV 相关口咽癌中优化 治疗 仍然具有挑战性,因为当前基于 TNM 和吸烟的风险分层无法捕获肿瘤的生物异质性,因此需要更好的预后生物标志物;本研究旨在验证免疫评分作为这样的生物标志物。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对 191 名 HPV 相关(p16+ 和 HPV DNA/RNA+)OPSCC 患者(2015-2024 年)进行的免疫评分国际多中心验证,包括一项法国单中心回顾性训练 队列研究 (n=48) 和三项验证 队列研究(法国回顾性 n=48、法国前瞻性 n=50、美国回顾性 n=45),其中 IS使用训练 队列研究 中定义的截止值通过肿瘤核心和侵袭性边缘中的 CD3+ 和 CD8+ 密度进行量化,并在 队列研究 中进行验证。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过流式细胞术测量免疫评分,评估肿瘤核心和浸润边缘的 CD3+ 和 CD8+ 细胞密度,并将无病生存期、总生存期和复发时间定义为主要结局;通过多变量 Cox 模型和 C 指数比较来评估关联性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 中位患者年龄为65岁,其中80%为男性,74%为吸烟者,66%为T1‐2期,82%为N0‐1期;IS‐High患者表现出显著更高的3年无病生存率(log‐rank P < .05),且IS‐Low是无病生存期(DFS)的独立预后因素,其风险比(HR)为9.03(95%置信区间4.02‐20.31;P < .001);结合IS‐临床模型可改善DFS预测(C‐指数0.82 vs 0.70;P < .0001),且在复发时间及总生存期的预测中也观察到类似改善,而IS‐High肿瘤相较于免疫贫乏的IS‐Low肿瘤表现出更丰富的淋巴样和髓样细胞群体。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,Immunoscore 在预后表现方面优于临床变量,并确定了生物学上不同的风险组,这些风险组可能能够实现生物标志物引导、风险适应的 治疗 策略,这代表了免疫评分在 HPV 相关口咽癌中的首次验证。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,免疫评分可用于对患者进行风险适应治疗分层,有可能改善 HPV 相关口咽癌的临床决策和结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于来自有限地理区域的回顾性和前瞻性 队列研究 以及来自单一训练 队列研究 的截止值,再加上证据仅是抽象的事实,限制了置信度,但多中心设计和大样本量提供了中等的证据强度。

title: Decision-making process and support needs regarding the human papillomavirus vaccine in Japan: a qualitative interview study with mothers
abstract: This study aimed to clarify the decision-making process and support needs of mothers with daughters eligible for human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 15 Japanese mothers, representing 17 eligible daughters aged 12–20 years. Thematic analysis was performed for data analysis. We extracted 41 concept codes and 15 categories and classified them into four analytical themes: “facilitators of decision-making,” “inhibitors of decision-making,” “fluctuations in the decision-making process,” and “support that mothers need.” Mothers experienced emotional fluctuations and conflicts throughout the decision-making process, repeatedly feeling anxious and reassured and weighing their expectations against their concerns while trying to make a decision they considered satisfactory. Their information and support needs varied across the decision-making process. Mothers experienced emotional fluctuations and conflicts throughout the HPV vaccination decision-making process, and their information and support needs varied according to their individual concerns and readiness to make a decision. Therefore, decision-making support should be responsive to each mother’s concerns and needs throughout the decision-making process. Interprofessional collaboration may also be important in providing mothers with appropriate information and support. These findings may contribute to the development of tailored support for HPV vaccination decision-making in Japan.

title: Backward and Hopf bifurcations in a human papillomavirus–cancer model with imperfect vaccination and waning immunity
abstract: Introduction Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the most common sexually transmitted infection and the cause of virtually all cervical cancer, yet elimination is complicated by two features of real vaccination programmes: available vaccines are imperfect, leaving vaccinated individuals partially susceptible, and naturally acquired immunity wanes. We ask whether reducing the basic reproduction number below unity is sufficient for elimination when both mechanisms are present. Methods We formulate and analyse a six-compartment ( SEIRVC ) deterministic model combining an imperfect vaccine and waning immunity with explicit progression to an HPV-related cancer class. We establish positivity, boundedness, and an invariant region; derive R 0 by the next-generation matrix method; characterize the equilibria and their stability using Routh–Hurwitz criteria, Lyapunov functions, and the geometric approach of Li and Muldowney; and analyse the bifurcation structure, supported by sensitivity indices and simulation. Results The reproduction number decomposes additively into a susceptible and a vaccine-breakthrough route, and the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable precisely when R 0 < 1, and globally so under an explicit condition. Reducing the endemic equilibria to the roots of a quadratic shows that a leaky vaccine together with waning immunity produces a backward bifurcation, so that R 0 < 1 is necessary but not sufficient for elimination and control must clear a turning point R 0 c 1 . Above threshold the unique endemic equilibrium can lose stability through a Hopf bifurcation, giving sustained oscillations whose amplitude is magnified in the cancer class, which varies by a factor of order 10 2 within a cycle under constant parameters. Both phenomena require both mechanisms and vanish when the vaccine becomes perfectly protective or immunity permanent, the limit in which global stability of the endemic equilibrium is proved; two-parameter continuation shows the two regimes to be disjoint alternatives. Discussion Sensitivity analysis gives sgnΥ β = sgn(θ−λ H ) so scaling up an insufficiently protective vaccine raises R 0 , while the waning rate has zero elasticity yet determines both non-classical regimes. Threshold quantities alone are therefore an unreliable guide to HPV control, and surveillance must track prevalence over time.
journal: Frontiers in Applied Mathematics and Statistics

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 简介 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是最常见的性传播感染,也是几乎所有 宫颈癌 的原因,但真正的 疫苗接种 计划的两个特征使消除变得复杂:可用的 疫苗 不完善,使接种疫苗的个体部分易受影响,并且自然获得的免疫力减弱。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 提供的证据没有明确说明研究设计、设置或研究人群。
elements_zh.methods: 方法 我们制定并分析了六室 (SEIRVC) 确定性模型,该模型结合了不完善的 疫苗 和免疫力下降以及明确进展为 HPV 相关癌症类别的情况。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果繁殖数可加性地分解为易感路线和疫苗突破路线,并且当R 0 < 1时,无病平衡精确地局部渐近稳定,并且在显式条件下全局如此。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 因此,阈值数量本身并不是 HPV 控制的可靠指南,并且 监测 必须随着时间的推移跟踪 监测。

title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 中的后向分岔和 Hopf 分岔——具有不完善的 疫苗接种 和免疫力减弱的癌症模型
source_body_en: Introduction Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the most common sexually transmitted infection and the cause of virtually all cervical cancer, yet elimination is complicated by two features of real vaccination programmes: available vaccines are imperfect, leaving vaccinated individuals partially susceptible, and naturally acquired immunity wanes. We ask whether reducing the basic reproduction number below unity is sufficient for elimination when both mechanisms are present. Methods We formulate and analyse a six-compartment ( SEIRVC ) deterministic model combining an imperfect vaccine and waning immunity with explicit progression to an HPV-related cancer class. We establish positivity, boundedness, and an invariant region; derive R 0 by the next-generation matrix method; characterize the equilibria and their stability using Routh–Hurwitz criteria, Lyapunov functions, and the geometric approach of Li and Muldowney; and analyse the bifurcation structure, supported by sensitivity indices and simulation. Results The reproduction number decomposes additively into a susceptible and a vaccine-breakthrough route, and the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable precisely when R 0 < 1, and globally so under an explicit condition. Reducing the endemic equilibria to the roots of a quadratic shows that a leaky vaccine together with waning immunity produces a backward bifurcation, so that R 0 < 1 is necessary but not sufficient for elimination and control must clear a turning point R 0 c 1 . Above threshold the unique endemic equilibrium can lose stability through a Hopf bifurcation, giving sustained oscillations whose amplitude is magnified in the cancer class, which varies by a factor of order 10 2 within a cycle under constant parameters. Both phenomena require both mechanisms and vanish when the vaccine becomes perfectly protective or immunity permanent, the limit in which global stability of the endemic equilibrium is proved; two-parameter continuation shows the two regimes to be disjoint alternatives. Discussion Sensitivity analysis gives sgnΥ β = sgn(θ−λ H ) so scaling up an insufficiently protective vaccine raises R 0 , while the waning rate has zero elasticity yet determines both non-classical regimes. Threshold quantities alone are therefore an unreliable guide to HPV control, and surveillance must track prevalence over time.

title: Changing epidemiology and survival of HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer in Denmark: four decades of population-based data
abstract: Background Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) has undergone substantial epidemiological and clinical changes, with an increasing proportion of human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated tumours and declining tobacco exposure. We investigated temporal changes in patient characteristics, HPV/p16 status, treatment patterns, and survival among patients with OPSCC in Denmark. Methods Patients with OPSCC were identified from the Copenhagen Oropharyngeal Cancer Database (2000–2023) and the Danish National Patient Cancer Registry (DCR; 1980–2021). The Copenhagen database provided detailed clinical and pathological data, including HPV/p16 status, while the DCR enabled assessment of long-term survival trends. Temporal changes were evaluated across diagnostic periods. Overall survival, relative survival, and restricted mean survival time were estimated. Results Among 3,631 OPSCC patients in the Copenhagen database, median age at diagnosis increased from 59 years in 2000–2005 to 64 years in 2018–2023 (p<0.001). The proportion of HPV+/p16+ patients increased significantly from 43.5% in 2000–2005 to 62.8% in 2018-2023. The proportion of never smokers also increased from 0.5% to 23.5%, while ≥20 pack-years decreased from 73.2% to 52.1% (p<0.001). Treatment patterns changed substantially, with radiotherapy alone decreasing from 87.6% to 27.9% and chemoradiotherapy increasing from 1.6% to 46.3%. Among 9,379 patients in the DCR, five-year relative survival increased from 31.8% in 1980–1984 to 70.1% in 2015-2019. Among HPV+/p16+ patients, five-year overall survival increased from 63.1% in 2000–2005 to 83.7% in 2018–2023. Conclusion In Denmark, OPSCC has undergone substantial epidemiological and therapeutic changes accompanied by marked improvements in survival, including among HPV+/p16+ patients.

title_zh: 丹麦 流行病学 的变化和 HPV 相关口咽癌的生存率:四十年的人口数据
source_body_en: Background Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) has undergone substantial epidemiological and clinical changes, with an increasing proportion of human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated tumours and declining tobacco exposure. We investigated temporal changes in patient characteristics, HPV/p16 status, treatment patterns, and survival among patients with OPSCC in Denmark. Methods Patients with OPSCC were identified from the Copenhagen Oropharyngeal Cancer Database (2000–2023) and the Danish National Patient Cancer Registry (DCR; 1980–2021). The Copenhagen database provided detailed clinical and pathological data, including HPV/p16 status, while the DCR enabled assessment of long-term survival trends. Temporal changes were evaluated across diagnostic periods. Overall survival, relative survival, and restricted mean survival time were estimated. Results Among 3,631 OPSCC patients in the Copenhagen database, median age at diagnosis increased from 59 years in 2000–2005 to 64 years in 2018–2023 (p<0.001). The proportion of HPV+/p16+ patients increased significantly from 43.5% in 2000–2005 to 62.8% in 2018-2023. The proportion of never smokers also increased from 0.5% to 23.5%, while ≥20 pack-years decreased from 73.2% to 52.1% (p<0.001). Treatment patterns changed substantially, with radiotherapy alone decreasing from 87.6% to 27.9% and chemoradiotherapy increasing from 1.6% to 46.3%. Among 9,379 patients in the DCR, five-year relative survival increased from 31.8% in 1980–1984 to 70.1% in 2015-2019. Among HPV+/p16+ patients, five-year overall survival increased from 63.1% in 2000–2005 to 83.7% in 2018–2023. Conclusion In Denmark, OPSCC has undergone substantial epidemiological and therapeutic changes accompanied by marked improvements in survival, including among HPV+/p16+ patients.

title: Prognostic relevance of cutavirus DNA in human papillomavirus DNA-negative oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma: a retrospective cohort study
abstract: Abstract Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) status is the strongest prognostic determinant in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). As HPV-positive and HPV-negative OPSCC represent distinct disease entities, the prevalence and prognostic relevance of other viral infections may differ between these subgroups. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of tumor-associated viruses in OPSCC according to HPV DNA status and evaluate their association with clinical outcomes, with particular emphasis on HPV DNA-negative disease. Methods Tumor specimens from 106 Japanese patients with OPSCC were analyzed for the presence of HPV, cutavirus (CuV), Epstein–Barr virus (EBV), human cytomegalovirus (HCMV), and Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCPyV) using real-time polymerase chain reaction. Viral prevalence and loads were assessed according to HPV DNA status, and associations between viral detection and clinicopathological characteristics were evaluated. Progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) were analyzed using Kaplan–Meier methods and Cox proportional hazards regression models. Results In the overall cohort, HPV, CuV, EBV, HCMV, and MCPyV DNA was detected in 47 (44%), 23 (22%), 21 (20%), 6 (6%), and 1 (1%) cases, respectively. Among HPV DNA-negative OPSCC cases ( n = 59), CuV, EBV, HCMV, and MCPyV DNA was detected in 14 (24%), 8 (14%), 3 (5%), and 1 (2%) cases, respectively. Viral loads did not differ significantly according to HPV DNA status. Within the HPV DNA-negative subgroup, CuV DNA positivity was significantly associated with shorter PFS (log-rank P < 0.001), whereas no significant association was observed with OS. Univariable Cox regression analysis identified CuV DNA positivity as the only viral factor significantly associated with PFS in HPV DNA-negative OPSCC (hazard ratio, 3.14; 95% confidence interval, 1.55–6.35; P = 0.001). CuV DNA positivity remained significantly associated with shorter PFS after adjustment for clinicopathological factors, whereas EBV, HCMV, and MCPyV DNA positivity was not significantly associated with clinical outcomes. Conclusions CuV DNA positivity was associated with shorter PFS in HPV DNA-negative OPSCC. CuV DNA positivity may have prognostic relevance in HPV DNA-negative OPSCC, although its biological significance and causal relevance remain unclear. Larger studies are warranted to validate these findings and further clarify the significance of CuV DNA detection in OPSCC.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) status is the strongest prognostic determinant in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). As HPV-positive and HPV-negative OPSCC represent distinct disease entities, the prevalence and prognostic relevance of other viral infections may differ between these subgroups. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of tumor-associated viruses in OPSCC according to HPV DNA status and evaluate their association with clinical outcomes, with particular emphasis on HPV DNA-negative disease. Methods Tumor specimens from 106 Japanese patients with OPSCC were analyzed for the presence of HPV, cutavirus (CuV), Epstein–Barr virus (EBV), human cytomegalovirus (HCMV), and Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCPyV) using real-time polymerase chain reaction. Viral prevalence and loads were assessed according to HPV DNA status, and associations between viral detection and clinicopathological characteristics were evaluated. Progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) were analyzed using Kaplan–Meier methods and Cox proportional hazards regression models. Results In the overall cohort, HPV, CuV, EBV, HCMV, and MCPyV DNA was detected in 47 (44%), 23 (22%), 21 (20%), 6 (6%), and 1 (1%) cases, respectively. Among HPV DNA-negative OPSCC cases ( n = 59), CuV, EBV, HCMV, and MCPyV DNA was detected in 14 (24%), 8 (14%), 3 (5%), and 1 (2%) cases, respectively. Viral loads did not differ significantly according to HPV DNA status. Within the HPV DNA-negative subgroup, CuV DNA positivity was significantly associated with shorter PFS (log-rank P < 0.001), whereas no significant association was observed with OS. Univariable Cox regression analysis identified CuV DNA positivity as the only viral factor significantly associated with PFS in HPV DNA-negative OPSCC (hazard ratio, 3.14; 95% confidence interval, 1.55–6.35; P = 0.001). CuV DNA positivity remained significantly associated with shorter PFS after adjustment for clinicopathological factors, whereas EBV, HCMV, and MCPyV DNA positivity was not significantly associated with clinical outcomes. Conclusions CuV DNA positivity was associated with shorter PFS in HPV DNA-negative OPSCC. CuV DNA positivity may have prognostic relevance in HPV DNA-negative OPSCC, although its biological significance and causal relevance remain unclear. Larger studies are warranted to validate these findings and further clarify the significance of CuV DNA detection in OPSCC.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 状态是口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPSCC) 最强的预后决定因素。由于 HPV 阳性和 HPV 阴性 OPSCC 代表不同的疾病实体,因此这些亚组之间的 患病率 和其他病毒感染的预后相关性可能有所不同。本研究旨在根据 HPV DNA 状态确定 OPSCC 中肿瘤相关病毒的 患病率,并评估其与临床结果的关联,特别是 HPV DNA 阴性疾病。方法 使用实时聚合酶链反应分析 106 名日本 OPSCC 患者的肿瘤标本中是否存在 HPV、皮肤病毒 (CuV)、EB 病毒 (EBV)、人类巨细胞病毒 (HCMV) 和默克尔细胞多瘤病毒 (MCPyV)。根据 HPV DNA 状态评估病毒 患病率 和载量,并评估病毒检测与临床病理特征之间的关联。使用 Kaplan-Meier 方法和 Cox 比例风险回归模型分析无进展生存期 (PFS) 和总生存期 (OS)。结果 在总体 队列研究 中,分别在 47 例(44%)、23 例(22%)、21 例(20%)、6 例(6%)和 1 例(1%)病例中检测到 HPV、CuV、EBV、HCMV 和 MCPyV DNA。在 HPV DNA 阴性 OPSCC 病例中 ( n = 59),分别在 14 例 (24%)、8 例 (14%)、3 例 (5%) 和 1 例 (2%) 例中检测到 CuV、EBV、HCMV 和 MCPyV DNA。根据 HPV DNA 状态,病毒载量没有显着差异。在 HPV DNA 阴性亚组中,CuV DNA 阳性与较短的 PFS 显着相关(对数秩 P < 0.001),而与 OS 没有显着相关。单变量 Cox 回归分析确定 CuV DNA 阳性是与 HPV DNA 阴性 OPSCC 中 PFS 显着相关的唯一病毒因素(风险比,3.14;95% 置信区间,1.55–6.35;P = 0.001)。在调整临床病理因素后,CuV DNA 阳性仍然与较短的 PFS 显着相关,而 EBV、HCMV 和 MCPyV DNA 阳性与临床结果没有显着相关。结论 CuV DNA 阳性与 HPV DNA 阴性 OPSCC 中较短的 PFS 相关。CuV DNA 阳性可能与 HPV DNA 阴性 OPSCC 具有预后相关性,尽管其生物学意义和因果相关性仍不清楚。需要进行更大规模的研究来验证这些发现并进一步阐明 CuV DNA 检测在 OPSCC 中的重要性。

title: Urban–Rural Disparities in Knowledge and Awareness of Human Papillomavirus and The Hpv Vaccine Among Adults in Sargodha District, Punjab, Pakistan
abstract: HPV vaccination and screening are the main strategies to prevent cervical cancer, but a foundation for gaining acceptance of vaccination is an understanding of HPV. The methods employed were a cross sectional survey of adults (age 18 and above) and the questionnaire was validated and translated (English/Urdu) and was administered during seven weeks in urban and rural Sargodha. Recruitment was stratified quota (125 urban, 125 rural) and the administration was mixed (online and paper administered by interviewer). The scores of 17 knowledge items were added together (range 0–17, ≥10 = adequate). The difference among groups was analyzed by chi square/Fisher's exact, t and Mann–Whitney tests. Crude and adjusted prevalence ratios (PR) were used to determine factors associated with adequate knowledge and vaccine awareness. 250 questionnaires were completed and analysed from a total of 287 questionnaires started. There was a significantly higher level of HPV awareness among urban respondents (67.2%) compared with rural respondents (31.2%) and HPV vaccine awareness among urban respondents (58.4%) compared with rural respondents (24.8%) (both p < 0.001). Adequate knowledge was found in 22.4% overall (urban 37.6%, rural 7.2%; p < 0.001). 58.8% (urban 70.4% and rural 47.2%) were willing to vaccinate or Page 1 of 13 Urban–Rural Disparities in Knowledge and Awareness of HPV and the HPV Vaccine among Adults in Sargodha, Pakistan allow vaccination and 4.4% had been vaccinated before. Problems with knowledge (80.6%), safety concerns (63.1%) and cost (55.3%) were the primary barriers among 103 respondents who were unwilling or not sure. The most trusted source of recommendation was physicians. Following adjustment, rural living was still correlated with lower The strongest positive correlates were adequate knowledge (PR 0.42; 95% CI 0.21–0.84) and lower vaccine awareness (PR 0.61; 0.43–0.87); graduate education (PR 3.64) and healthcare employment (PR 2.55) were the strongest positive correlates. Knowledge level of adults about HPV and HPV vaccines is limited and this is significantly lower in rural areas, which can be attributed to education and socio economic status, although not entirely. Attitudes towards vaccination are more prevalent than knowledge.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the knowledge and awareness gaps regarding human papillomavirus (HPV) and the HPV vaccine among adults in Sargodha District, Punjab, Pakistan, given the importance of understanding HPV for vaccine acceptance and prevention of cervical cancer.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional survey of adults (age 18 and above) was conducted in urban and rural Sargodha over seven weeks, with stratified quota sampling (125 urban, 125 rural) and mixed administration (online and paper by interviewer).
analysis.methods: The study employed a validated and translated questionnaire (English/Urdu) and analyzed 250 completed questionnaires from a total of 287 started.
analysis.main_results: Urban respondents had significantly higher awareness of HPV (67.2%) and the HPV vaccine (58.4%) compared to rural respondents (31.2% and 24.8%, respectively). Adequate knowledge was found in 22.4% overall, with urban respondents at 37.6% and rural at 7.2% (p < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that knowledge about HPV and the HPV vaccine was significantly lower in rural areas, with education and socio-economic status being key factors. Attitudes towards vaccination were more prevalent than knowledge.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted interventions are needed to improve knowledge and awareness of HPV and the HPV vaccine in rural areas to enhance vaccine acceptance and prevent cervical cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample size and the mixed administration method, which may introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study found significantly lower knowledge and awareness of HPV and the HPV vaccine among rural adults compared to urban adults in Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan, highlighting the need for targeted interventions in rural areas.

elements_zh.main_results: 与农村受访者(分别为31.2%和24.8%)相比,城市受访者对HPV(67.2%)和HPV 疫苗(58.4%)的认知度显着较高。总体而言,22.4% 的受访者拥有足够的知识,其中城市受访者为 37.6%,农村受访者为 7.2% (p < 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,农村地区对 HPV 和 HPV 疫苗 的了解明显较低,教育和社会经济地位是关键因素。对 疫苗接种 的态度比知识更普遍。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要采取有针对性的干预措施,提高农村地区对 HPV 和 HPV 疫苗 的认识和认识,以提高对 疫苗 的接受度并预防 疫苗。

title: Biologic therapies for psoriasis and outcomes on mucosal human papillomavirus infections: a systematic review and narrative synthesis
abstract: Abstract Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) infections are common and may be influenced by immunomodulatory biologics used for psoriasis. The influence of tumour necrosis factor (TNF)-α, interleukin (IL)-12/23, IL-17 and IL-23 inhibition on mucosal HPV outcomes remains uncertain. Objectives To systematically review the clinical evidence on the occurrence, regression and recurrence of mucosal HPV infections in patients treated with biologics approved to treat psoriasis, and to provide a complementary narrative synthesis of cutaneous or indirect HPV findings. Methods A systematic search of PubMed, Embase and Scopus (from inception to October 2025) identified studies reporting HPV outcomes in patients receiving biologics approved to treat psoriasis, irrespective of the treatment indication. Data extraction and quality assessment followed standardized procedures. Results Forty-one studies met the inclusion criteria; 18 addressed mucosal HPV outcomes and 23 contributed to the narrative synthesis. The overall methodological quality was low to moderate. No consistent population-level increase in anogenital HPV risk was found with anti-TNF therapy, although sporadic cases of condyloma were reported. IL-17 inhibitors yielded heterogeneous and context-dependent findings, including a possible increase in oral HPV detection, without a consistent genital HPV signal. Ustekinumab showed mixed outcomes, with exacerbations and documented regressions. Selective IL-23 inhibitors were not associated with a clear increased risk of mucosal HPV, based on very limited data; isolated regression has been reported. Cutaneous HPV manifestations under biologics were uncommon and generally benign. Conclusions The current evidence does not indicate a clear increased risk of mucosal HPV infection in people taking biologics approved to treat psoriasis, although isolated exacerbations may occur. Prospective studies, including the CONDYPSO project, are needed to clarify causal links and to guide preventive strategies such as HPV vaccination and mucosal surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examined how biologic therapies for psoriasis affect mucosal human papillomavirus (HPV) outcomes. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Embase and Scopus up to October 2025 yielded 41 studies, with 18 reporting mucosal HPV outcomes. Overall methodological quality was low to moderate. Findings indicate no consistent population‐level increase in anogenital HPV risk with anti‐TNF agents, while IL‐17 inhibitors showed heterogeneous results, including a possible rise in oral HPV detection. Ustekinumab produced mixed outcomes, and selective IL‐23 inhibitors did not demonstrate a clear risk increase, though data were limited. Cutaneous HPV manifestations were uncommon and benign. The evidence does not support a clear heightened risk of mucosal HPV infection with these biologics, though isolated exacerbations may occur. Gaps include limited data on IL‐23 inhibitors, heterogeneity in IL‐17 findings, and overall low study quality. Future prospective research, such as the CONDYPSO project, is essential to establish causal relationships and inform preventive measures like HPV vaccination and mucosal surveillance.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染很常见,可能受到用于治疗银屑病的免疫调节生物制剂的影响。肿瘤坏死因子 (TNF)-α、白细胞介素 (IL)-12/23、IL-17 和 IL-23 抑制对粘膜 HPV 结果的影响仍不确定。目的 系统评价接受批准用于治疗银屑病的生物制剂治疗的患者中粘膜 HPV 感染的发生、消退和复发的临床证据,并提供皮肤或间接 HPV 结果的补充性叙述综合。方法 对 PubMed、Embase 和 Scopus 进行系统检索(从成立到 2025 年 10 月),确定了报告接受批准用于治疗银屑病的生物制剂的患者 HPV 结果的研究,无论 治疗 适应症如何。数据提取和质量评估遵循标准化程序。结果 41 项研究符合纳入标准;18 篇讨论了粘膜 HPV 结果,23 篇对叙述性综合做出了贡献。总体方法学质量为低至中等。尽管有零星尖锐湿疣病例报道,但抗 TNF 治疗并未发现人群中肛门生殖器 HPV 风险持续增加。IL-17 抑制剂产生了异质性和环境依赖性的结果,包括口腔 HPV 检测可能增加,但生殖器 HPV 信号没有一致。乌司奴单抗的结果好坏参半,有恶化的情况,也有记录在案的消退的情况。根据非常有限的数据,选择性 IL-23 抑制剂与粘膜 HPV 风险明显增加无关;有孤立回归的报道。生物制剂下的皮肤 HPV 表现并不常见,而且通常是良性的。结论 目前的证据并未表明服用批准用于治疗银屑病的生物制剂的人粘膜 HPV 感染的风险明显增加,尽管可能会出现孤立的恶化。需要包括 CONDYPSO 项目在内的前瞻性研究来阐明因果关系并指导 HPV 疫苗接种 和粘膜 监测 等预防策略。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据质量为低至中等,有关 IL-23 抑制剂的数据非常有限。IL-17 研究结果的异质性和缺乏明确的因果关系凸显了尚未解决的机制。需要进行前瞻性研究来澄清关联并指导预防策略。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进行前瞻性研究,例如 CONDYPSO 项目,以澄清因果关系并指导预防策略,包括 HPV 疫苗接种 和粘膜 监测。

title: Acceptability and preference of self-collected vaginal samples for human papillomavirus DNA testing compared with physician-collected Pap smear.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Self-collected vaginal sampling for human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA testing provides a promising alternative to physician-collected Pap smears, especially in low-resource settings. However, data on its acceptability and preferences among Filipino women remain limited. This study aimed to assess women's perceptions, experiences, willingness and preferences regarding self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing compared with Pap smears. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 592 women. Participants underwent both physician-collected Pap smears and self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing. Perceptions were measured using five-point Likert scale questionnaires before and after self-collection. Descriptive statistics were used, and paired and independent Wilcoxon tests were used to compare Likert responses. Willingness to undergo screening was analyzed with Cochran's Q and McNemar tests. Participants' reasons for their preferred screening method were categorized thematically and displayed in stacked bar charts. RESULTS: Self-collection was generally viewed as painless, not uncomfortable, non-embarrassing, and easy and convenient. Acceptability significantly increased after participants performed self-collection (P < 0.001 for pain and discomfort). Compared with Pap smears, self-collection was seen as less embarrassing (P < 0.001), but rated as less easy (P = 0.01) and less convenient (P = 0.004). Most participants preferred physician-administered screening (84.8%) due to trust in medical expertise, and confidence in the procedure's accuracy, safety and cleanliness. CONCLUSIONS: Self-collected vaginal sampling was highly acceptable, yet physician-collected screening remained the preferred method. Improving education, demonstrations, and support for self-collection may enhance the uptake of HPV DNA testing and broaden access to cervical cancer screening in the Philippines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 自我采集阴道样本用于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)DNA检测为医生采集的巴氏涂片提供了一种有前景的替代方案,特别是在资源匮乏的环境中。然而,关于菲律宾女性对其可接受性和偏好的数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在592名女性中进行了一项横断面研究。参与者接受了医生采集的巴氏涂片和自我采集的阴道样本用于HPV DNA检测。
elements_zh.methods: 感知通过五点李克特量表问卷在自我采样前和后进行测量。使用描述性统计,并采用配对和独立样本威尔科克森检验来比较李克特量表的回答。接受筛查的意愿通过科克兰Q检验和麦克纳马检验进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 自我采集通常被认为无痛、不不适、不尴尬且容易和方便。参与者进行自我采集后,可接受性显著提高(疼痛和不适的P < 0.001)。与巴氏涂片相比,自我采集被认为更不尴尬(P < 0.001),但被认为更不便于操作(P = 0.01)和更不方便(P = 0.004)。大多数参与者由于对医疗专业知识的信任以及对程序准确性、安全性和清洁度的信心,更倾向于医生进行的筛查(84.8%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 自我采集阴道样本具有高度可接受性,但医生采集的筛查仍然是首选方法。通过改善自我采集的教育、演示和支持,可能提高HPV DNA检测的参与率,并扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可能通过强调自我采样方法的教育和支持需求,为提高菲律宾HPV DNA检测的接受度并扩大筛查可及性提供策略依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于菲律宾的单一人群,并未考虑长期行为变化。证据是温和的,因为它是基于自我报告的看法和经验。
